set.body:
Current remaining scope

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P2, update ingestion boundary to existing estimates. EstimateGroup already compiles pinned estimate inputs, validates participant/target/product/pooling identities with mandatory scientific/grid admission, and reads bounded spatial blocks into GroupData while retaining input receipts. Therefore a new FirstLevelCatalog-specific GroupBlockSource must not duplicate that reader or revive the retired ResultManifest authority. Remaining work is scheduler-neutral persisted group execution and output publication around EstimateGroup plus existing GroupEngine, with dense-versus-block independent equivalence, whole-call memory/read budgets and lineage-preserving result sinks. Include repeated integrity-scan costs from the current reader in performance receipts. Do not conflate supplied variances with calibrated inference; admission/provenance and estimator expansion remain their own P1/research tasks. Preserve missing/invalid input refusals and the stable estimate-format dependency without requiring unrelated app orchestration. Source inspection only; no new execution/performance qualification.

Original acceptance (reader vocabulary superseded above)

Run second-level and meta-analytic models from first-level manifests without constructing a full subjects by samples GroupData matrix.

Scope:
- Add a GroupBlockSource over FirstLevelCatalog entries with exact subject or unit ordering, contrast identity, variance availability, and GroupSpace validation.
- Define scheduler-neutral group work descriptors, kernels, deterministic reducers, and transactional result sinks over spatial blocks.
- Reuse the existing group estimators and keep estimator-parity expansion in its existing bead; this slice owns scalable ingestion and execution around them.
- Reject missing maps, incompatible spaces or masks, duplicate units, and invalid variance policy through typed errors before numerical execution.

Acceptance:
- OLS and at least one variance-aware group path run from a persisted first-level catalog in bounded spatial blocks.
- Blockwise and dense reference results agree within explicit tolerances.
- Peak response payload memory scales with subjects times block size, not subjects times whole image.
- Second-level named maps and manifests preserve model, contrast, geometry, sample cohort, and first-level lineage.
set.title: Execute persisted group spatial blocks through the native estimate-set reader
